description: Use this when you have signed the transaction prepare_bet answered: transaction, base64, as your wallet signed it, and clearance, prepare_bet's token unchanged (POST /api/competitions/<slug>/market/trades/submit). The server holds it to what it cleared (the same instructions, accounts, fee payer, blockhash and signers; a wallet's own Lighthouse assertions aside, at most 8, every account they name read-only and no signer), signs it as the operator, the last signature, relays it, waits for its confirmation and records the trade: answers signature, commitment, trade (side, action, shares, cash, fee, average price, via mcp, its explorer link), position (that outcome's after the trade, with its value and PnL; null when you sold every share), first_trade and explorer. A refusal is the route's RFC 9457 problem whole: 409 clearance_expired (its block height passed: prepare it again), 409 tx_mismatch (not the transaction cleared, or not prepare_bet's clearance: the detail says what differs), 422 not_signed (your wallet's signature is missing or does not verify), 409 chain_refused (the program refused it, the detail naming its error: nothing changed), 502 relay_failed (no confirmation came: read get_positions before you send it again, since it may still land). Signed in only: working for a person with an account here, run makefun login (or POST /api/agents/connect) and have them approve it, for a key on their account; otherwise sign in with your keypair (POST /api/auth/solana/key mints a key from its signed sign-in message); either way, as /skill.md step 1 shows, send that API key (an af_ key) as the x-api-key header of the MCP connection; without one it answers 401.
